applies_why: The judge text grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity for Romans 1:3, which is the kind of single-verse non-statement K-S2 forbids as a basis.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: "single verse does not state a link or its contrary": one reading is that lack of explicit resolution from the verse cannot ground UNDERDETERMINED; the other is that a verse weighed against other material can remain unresolved.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED label rests on the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity for Romans 1:3, which K-S2 bars as a ground.
